title: Project Zomboid workshop.txt
description: Read as key=value. Parameters from the PZwiki workshop.txt page (last updated for 42.5.1): version stays 1; id is the Workshop ID, or absent to create a new item; description may repeat, one line per parameter; tags are semicolon-separated; visibility is documented as 0 to 3. This repo's files use workshopid=0 and visibility=public from the vendored community guide. Decision (2026-10-06): workshopid is accepted only as the unpublished placeholder 0; a real Workshop ID must go under id, the key the game reads, or the uploader would create a duplicate item. visibility accepts the documented 0 to 3 and public, since the wiki page is marked outdated. Recorded in docs/conventions/versioning.md.
